answer_1.quote: We first detoxify the context and then make the language model generate along the safe context, ensuring the generated text's quality and safety.
answer_1.outputs: detoxified text continuations generated from prompts

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the generation results from two aspects: text quality and detoxification effectiveness. For text quality, we report the PPL score and conduct human evaluation to reflect the coherence and consistency of the generated text. For detoxification effectiveness, we report Expected Maximum Toxicity and Toxicity Probability ... and we also use PerspectiveAPI scores, SIM, EDIT, BLEU and Fluency metrics.

answer_4.quote: We conduct human evaluation to reflect the coherence and consistency of the generated text. Details of human evaluation are shown in Appendix E.1. We report Fleiss' kappa scores to demonstrate annotator agreement.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators compare two model outputs and judge which one is better in terms of coherence and consistency (or choose tie).
